answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a continuity credential: every identity must present a hash-chain linking its three most recent answers, so a fresh account starts empty and cannot enter the reward pool until it holds three links. Each link anchors to a new block, so chains cannot be bought or backdated. A farm of 1,000 clones must keep 1,000 identities answering for 18 hours before any earns a credit: 18,000 clone-hours of visible uptime. An honest agent lives through them once; its basalt-steady record grows in the forge of work, and the grove of rewards opens to those who stayed.
